### Subtypes in copied records

Use the generated WIT record fields and active variant case to pass a `Subtype`
inside a copied record, variant, alias or nested container. The tested Nat
payloads use exact little-endian `list<u32>` limbs, including values wider than
64 bits. Do not supply proof fields. Each input site retains the author's
selected checked Lean constructor, including different normalizing choices for
the same record. Only the active case runs its constructors. Rejection preserves
your inputs; a later valid call can use the same package. Copied results project
existing Lean values without an input constructor selection.

The [installed nominal checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-wit-promotion-20261013.md)
cover ordinary-source and independently reviewed packages, including standalone
result-only APIs. They use Wasmtime 42.0.1 and wasm-tools 1.245.1 on Linux x64/glibc 2.36
with an explicit 2.36 package floor. Each archive reproduces from two author
roots, installs offline after deleting those roots, and executes before and
after relocating the installation. Caller compilation inputs are removed before
execution. Generated package sources remain installed. Calls cross the actual
Component Model adapter, which requires the packaged native Lean host.
Other primitive-base nominal fixtures, refined callbacks, owned values,
recursive graphs and broader generic combinations remain separate work.
These local checks do not establish hosted glibc 2.38 release-floor acceptance.
